title: A fixed Chow immersion closes at a later stage
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, D an inverse system of schemes with affine transitions [pqf-def-affine-morphism], and S its limit [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition]. Fix i₀ and qcqs Sᵢ₀, X₀, Y₀ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], with a morphism f₀ of Sᵢ₀-schemes locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Write Xᵢ, Yᵢ, fᵢ for its base changes [def-pc-fibre-product]. Assume the pullback f at S is proper [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Fix i₁ ≥ i₀ with fᵢ₁ separated, n ≥ 0, and a given diagram T₁ → Xᵢ₁ and T₁ → ℙⁿ(Yᵢ₁) [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change], with π₁ proper and surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism], j₁ an immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], and j₁ followed by the projective projection equal to π₁ followed by fᵢ₁. Then some i ≥ i₁ admits maps π: T₁ × over Sᵢ₁ Sᵢ → Xᵢ and j: T₁ × over Sᵢ₁ Sᵢ → ℙⁿ(Yᵢ) such that π is surjective, j is a closed immersion, the analogous triangle commutes, and fᵢ is separated. The source is the base change of the given T₁ and the number of projective coordinates stays fixed.

source.place: Tag 081F (lemma-eventually-proper), the proof after choosing the Chow diagram; Tag 01ZP for closed-immersion descent

proof.text: Restrict to the cofinal directed tail above i₁, which has the same limit. Affine transitions and their base changes give qcqs stage source, target and base. Pasting pullback squares identifies the iterated pullback of f₁ with the original f at the limit and fᵢ at later stages.

Base change the given Chow diagram to the limit. The map π stays proper and surjective and j stays an immersion. The composite π followed by f is proper, whereas projective space is separated over the target. Thus j is proper over a separated target and, being an immersion, is closed.

At i₁ the source T₁ and projective space are qcqs, since each is proper over a qcqs scheme. The immersion j₁ is locally of finite type. Apply closed-immersion descent to j₁ over Sᵢ₁ and the tail diagram. It gives i ≥ i₁ with the base-changed j a closed immersion.

Use pullback pasting and the projective-space base-change isomorphism to identify the source with T₁ × over Sᵢ₁ Sᵢ and the target with projective space over the original Yᵢ. Transfer the two maps and the triangle through these isomorphisms. Base change preserves surjectivity of π₁ and separatedness of f₁. Functoriality identifies Sᵢ → Sᵢ₀ with the transition composite.

theorem exists_closed_chow_stage
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (t : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map t)]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c) (i₀ : I)
    [CompactSpace (D.obj (op i₀))] [QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj (op i₀))]
    (X₀ Y₀ : Over (D.obj (op i₀)))
    [CompactSpace X₀.left] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X₀.left]
    [CompactSpace Y₀.left] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y₀.left]
    (f₀ : X₀ ⟶ Y₀) [LocallyOfFiniteType f₀.left]
    (hf : IsProper (((Over.pullback (c.π.app (op i₀))).map f₀).left))
    (i₁ : I) (h₁ : i₀ ≤ i₁)
    (hsep : IsSeparated (((Over.pullback (D.map (homOfLE h₁).op)).map f₀).left))
    (n : ℕ) (T₁ : Scheme.{u})
    (π₁ : T₁ ⟶ ((Over.pullback (D.map (homOfLE h₁).op)).obj X₀).left)
    (j₁ : T₁ ⟶ ProjectiveSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)))
      ((Over.pullback (D.map (homOfLE h₁).op)).obj Y₀).left)
    (hπ₁ : IsProper π₁) (hsurj₁ : Surjective π₁) (hj₁ : IsImmersion j₁)
    (hw₁ : j₁ ≫ ProjectiveSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)))
      ((Over.pullback (D.map (homOfLE h₁).op)).obj Y₀).left ↘
        ((Over.pullback (D.map (homOfLE h₁).op)).obj Y₀).left =
      π₁ ≫ ((Over.pullback (D.map (homOfLE h₁).op)).map f₀).left) :
    ∃ (i : I) (h₁i : i₁ ≤ i)
      (π : pullback (π₁ ≫ ((Over.pullback (D.map (homOfLE h₁).op)).obj X₀).hom)
          (D.map (homOfLE h₁i).op) ⟶
        ((Over.pullback (D.map (homOfLE (h₁.trans h₁i)).op)).obj X₀).left)
      (j : pullback (π₁ ≫ ((Over.pullback (D.map (homOfLE h₁).op)).obj X₀).hom)
          (D.map (homOfLE h₁i).op) ⟶
        ProjectiveSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)))
          ((Over.pullback (D.map (homOfLE (h₁.trans h₁i)).op)).obj Y₀).left),
      Surjective π ∧ IsClosedImmersion j ∧
        j ≫ ProjectiveSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)))
          ((Over.pullback (D.map (homOfLE (h₁.trans h₁i)).op)).obj Y₀).left ↘
            ((Over.pullback (D.map (homOfLE (h₁.trans h₁i)).op)).obj Y₀).left =
          π ≫ ((Over.pullback (D.map (homOfLE (h₁.trans h₁i)).op)).map f₀).left ∧
        IsSeparated (((Over.pullback (D.map (homOfLE (h₁.trans h₁i)).op)).map f₀).left)
